potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User encounters an empty cart and is prompted to return to shopping.

steps.element_description: Message indicating the cart is empty.
Return to Shop button.

expected_outcome: User is redirected to the store page to continue shopping.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User explores product categories from the cart page.

steps.element_description: Link to Women Jeans category.
Link to Men Shirts category.

expected_outcome: User views the selected product category pages.

steps.element_description: Accessibility toolbar button.
Increase text size option.

expected_outcome: The page text size is increased for better readability.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users adjust the page's accessibility settings for better usability.

steps.element_description: Button to increase text size.
Button to enable high contrast mode.

expected_outcome: Page accessibility is enhanced according to the user's preferences.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users fill out the contact form to reach customer support.

steps.element_description: Form field for the user's name.
Form field for the user's email address.
Form field for the user's message.
Button to submit the contact form.

expected_outcome: The user's message is sent to customer support for further assistance.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User browses through the women apparel category and selects an item to view details.

steps.element_description: Clickable link for the product item, e.g., 'Flamingo Tshirt'.
Product detail page is displayed with pricing and add-to-cart options.

expected_outcome: The user can view detailed information about the selected product and add it to the cart.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User applies filters to view accessories only and selects an item.

steps.element_description: Filter option labeled 'Accessories'.
Filtered product list showing accessories.

expected_outcome: The user sees a list of accessories and can proceed to select an item.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can browse through different product categories to find items of interest.

steps.element_description: Category link for Accessories, Men, or Women.

expected_outcome: User is redirected to the selected category page displaying relevant products.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can set a price range to filter products displayed in the store.

steps.element_description: Price range slider to set minimum and maximum prices.
Filter button to apply the price range.

expected_outcome: Filtered list of products within the specified price range is displayed.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can sort the products by different criteria for easier navigation.

steps.element_description: Dropdown menu to choose sorting criteria such as popularity or price.

expected_outcome: Products are sorted based on the selected criteria.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: Users can click on a product to view its detailed information and add it to the cart.

steps.element_description: Product link from the listing.

expected_outcome: Product detail page is displayed with options to add to the cart.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User navigates to the Men section to explore men's products.

steps.element_description: Navigation menu item labeled 'Men'.

expected_outcome: User is redirected to the Men product page.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User adjusts the website's appearance for better accessibility.

steps.element_description: Accessibility toolbar option, such as 'Increase Text'.

expected_outcome: The text size increases for improved readability.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User explores promotional offers available on the homepage.

steps.element_description: Promotional banner labeled 'Shop Now' under '20% Off On Tank Tops'.

expected_outcome: User is redirected to the tank tops product page with promotional details.
